scenes.setting: The Demoness of Despair's ice spear vanishes mid-air and she is erased a centimeter at a time — 'You aren't! You are…' — the seat left empty as though she had never sat there, and the hooded woman simply disappears

Trissy, doubling back into Backlund to hide among five million people, is lifted out of a public carriage and pinned by an infant's helplessness before the same black-eyed figure — then released, with the sapphire ring on her pinky shattered and lightless
scenes.text_anchor: the sapphire ring on her left pinky had somehow shattered

scenes.setting: Out of the mountain door and down the slope with the river in earshot — but the Shepherd catches him: wind blades, exploding flesh, a nightmare broken by an imagined Eternal Blazing Sun, an ice spear, plague and spider-silk; even burning free, Klein is coughing and cornered as the illusory book opens: 'I came, I saw, I record.'
